newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT -- Citicorp Equity initiated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -- Citicorp Equity initiated.

text.p: -- ING Barings announced Monday it was initiating coverage of Argentina's communications and energy holding Citicorp Equity Investments SA with a buy rating.
-- "The stock trades at a significant discount to our breakdown by business analysis," analyst Kathleen Breitenbach wrote in a report.
-- Its valuation shows the shares undervalued between 15-18 percent.
-- Its 12-month price target is US$5.60 per share, implying 29 percent appreciation, after incorporating an illiquidity discount.
-- Citicorp Equity Investments has a 50.2 percent stake of the shareholders equity of COINTEL, that has a controlling stake in Telefonica de Argentina.
